description: Details pursuant to condition 'C7 - Commercial Kitchen Extraction System - Odour Control' of planning reference 24/2819/FUL.

application_details.lead_developer_company_name: LBRuT Non-Comm Env Health Noise Issues

decision_conditions: In the absence of confirmation regarding the provision of an appropriate servicing and maintenance arrangement, the Council cannot be satisfied that neighbouring amenity would be adequately protected. Despite repeated requests from the Council, no satisfactory details on this have been submitted. The Council is unable to determine whether the development would avoid unacceptable impacts on neighbouring amenity and is therefore contrary to Policy 46 of the Adopted Local Plan (2025) and the Councils SPG for Food and Drink Establishments
